  subtitle?: string; // Line under the drawer heading (i18n key or a bare `{name}` template), resolved like `title`.
  rowClick?: boolean; // Clicking the row opens this drawer with that row's `params`.
};
type RowActionMode = "adaptive" | "inline"; // Row-action column layout.
type RowActionNavigate = RowActionNavigateBase & ({ screen: string; entity?: never; } | { entity: string; screen?: never; }); // Exactly one of `screen` / `entity` — mutual exclusivity is type-enforced (boot validator still rejects both/neither for untyped schemas).
type RowFieldExtractor = // Declarative row-field extractor — JSON-safe (no function prop, survives GET /api/schema / buildAppSchema).
  | {
    pick: string[];
  }
  | {
    map: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  }
;
type ScreenFallback = string | ScreenFallbackByReason; // Screen-level `fallback`: one screen for every reason, or one per reason.
type ScreenFallbackByReason = { [Reason in ScreenFallbackReason]?: string; }; // Per-reason fallback screens (same-feature short id or cross-feature QN).
type ScreenFallbackReason = "hidden" | "forbidden" | "notFound" | "error"; // Why a screen gate is not open.
type ScreenSlots = {
  header?: PlatformComponent;
  titleAction?: PlatformComponent; // entityEdit / actionForm: rendered on the right of the form title, same row.
  beforeForm?: PlatformComponent;
  afterForm?: PlatformComponent;
  sidebar?: PlatformComponent;
  footer?: PlatformComponent;
  footerPrimary?: boolean; // entityEdit wizard: marks `footer` as the sticky-footer primary action (pinned `max-sm:fixed` group on mobile) instead of the non-sticky secondary bucket it falls into by default alongside Back/Cancel.
  toolbar?: PlatformComponent;
};
type ScreenVisibility = DashboardPanelVisibility & {
  idParam?: string; // Payload key that receives the screen's route id (projectionDetail only).
};
type SecretMintConfirmStep = { // Post-reveal proof-of-receipt step.
  handler: string; // Write-handler QN dispatched when the confirm form is submitted.
  fields: Readonly<Record<string, FormFieldDefinition>>;
  layout: EditLayout;
  carry?: string[]; // Mint success-payload fields merged into the confirm payload (e.g. a short-lived setup token).
  submitLabel?: string;
  doneMessage?: string; // i18n key for the banner shown after a successful confirm when the screen declares no `redirect`.
};
type SecretsEditScreenDefinition = {
  id: string;
  type: "secretsEdit";
  nav?: ScreenNavSugar;
  detailFor?: string;
  description?: string;
  agent?: AgentScreenHints;
  dormant?: boolean; // Screen has no nav entry by design (opened via link or navved by the app); exempts it from the nav-area boot check.
  visibleWhen?: ScreenVisibility; // UI-only gate, also on direct URL access; handlers still enforce access.
  fallback?: ScreenFallback; // Same-feature short id or cross-feature QN `<feature>:screen:<id>` shown when `visibleWhen` is unmet (default: standard notice).
  secretKeys: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // field id -> qualified secret name (`<feature>:secret:<kebab>`).
  fieldLabels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // field id -> i18n key for the label.
  fieldHints?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; // field id -> i18n key for the hint, only where the declaration carries one.
  requiredFields?: string[]; // field ids whose declaration set `required: true`.
  fieldAccess?: Readonly<Record<string, AccessRule>>; // field id -> write access derived from the key's `writeRoles`.
  sections: SecretsEditSection[];
  access?: AccessRule;
};
type SelectOptionTone = (typeof SELECT_OPTION_TONES)[number];
type TextFieldDef = PiiAndFieldState & {
  type: "text";
  description?: string; // Optional free-text semantics for the AI agent manifest — never rendered; the i18n label is what users see.
  maxLength?: number;
  minLength?: number; // Lower bound enforced by the generated write schema, so short input is rejected by validation instead of reaching the handler.
  autoComplete?: string; // HTML `autocomplete` token for the rendered input (e.g. "one-time-code"), so browsers and password managers offer or suppress autofill correctly.
  required?: boolean;
  searchable?: boolean;
  sortable?: boolean;
  sortNulls?: SortNulls;
  filterable?: boolean; // Allows screen filters on this field.
  encrypted?: boolean;
  sensitive?: boolean;
  writeOnly?: boolean; // Write-only secret (API key): the value is never returned to clients.
  readAsInstruction?: boolean; // A later run reads this field's value as an instruction — prompt, rule, template.
  format?: "email" | "url" | "phone" | "password" | "month" | "iban"; // "password" is a pure render hint (masked input) — no storage semantics.
  default?: string;
  access?: FieldAccess;
  multiline?: boolean | { rows?: number; }; // Multiline text causes DefaultInput to render a <textarea> instead of <input type="text">.
};
type TranslationValue = string | PluralForms;
type WorkspaceSchema = {
  definition: WorkspaceDefinition;
  navMembers: string[];
};
